method: Browser screenshots of publicly accessible running Babylon demos at the normal 1280 × 720 viewport. No model or texture extraction. Resized/compressed by the media pipeline; no visual restyling.
use: Three limited editorial figures in the Webview engineering discussion, each with creator credit, source link and specific analysis. This is not a claim of third-party asset licensing for the Loopforge game; screenshots stay in the reference pack and are not game materials.
boundary: Screenshots illustrate visual techniques, not performance benchmarks. Any visible FPS is incidental to capture conditions. Newer demo versions do not establish compatibility with the project's pinned Babylon 9.30.0.

items.title: Glowing Espilit
items.creator: Michel Rousseau
items.lesson: Baked interior illumination and contact shadows; apply its room-lighting principle to the lobby, not its architectural style.

items.title: Flight Helmet
